assessment: This study presents a valuable evaluation of the distribution of monocytes and dendritic cells in the blood and nasopharyngeal aspirates of patients with mild respiratory tract infections. They report solid differences between monocytes and dendritic cells and variation with patient age, showing that during influenza A virus infection, the classical and intermediate monocyte numbers increased both, in blood and nasopharyngeal aspirates while DCs increased in the nasopharyngeal aspirates only. The work will be of broad interest to immunologists, lung biologists and infection disease community.
